clue.text: Tracing, for example, a tiny bit over a small coin

indicators.note: over here means lying across and covering, so the tiny bit wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: a particle is a minute piece of matter
a means one, written as the Roman numeral I
P stands for penny, the smallest British coin

explanation.surface: Someone tracing a design lays a scrap of paper over a little coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tracing' looks like an activity, but here it is a grammar example: the present participle of 'trace'.
explanation.definitionFit: Tracing is a verb form ending in -ing, an instance of the grammatical category in question.

clue.text: With difficulty, bear disfigurement

definitions.meaning: to carry something heavy with effort, as in lugging a bag about
a hunch or protruding lump on the back

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to lug something laboriously and a rounded deformity on the back.

clue.text: Author's catalogue by month only half complete

definitions.note: read as 'author is', so the noun stands alone

indicators.note: only half of the month's name is given, its first four letters

parts.note: November, the eleventh month
a list is a catalogue of items

explanation.surface: A writer's bibliography dated by month is only half finished.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Author's' stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay; 'by' simply places the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of fiction books is a kind of author.

clue.text: To Conservative, keeping opponents back is an elementary thing

indicators.note: back tells us to read the whole assembly from right to left
keeping means holding something inside, so the opponents go into the word To

parts.note: taken as written
Labour, abbreviated Lab, are the Conservatives' main political opponents

explanation.surface: A politician tells a Conservative colleague to keep rival party members at bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' and 'back' work on the whole assembly: the opponents sit inside To, then C is added and everything is read right to left. Labour are the Conservatives' traditional rivals in British politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobalt is a chemical element, so an elementary thing in the punning sense.

clue.text: Colleague is friendly, though not initially polite

indicators.note: not says a letter is to be taken away from the friendly word

parts.note: pally is informal British for friendly

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word polite

explanation.surface: A coworker is amiable but not at first very courteous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not initially polite' removes P, polite's first letter, from PALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: An associate or partner on the same side is a natural synonym for colleague.

clue.text: Struggling to lose pounds, going to bed?

indicators.note: to lose means some letters drop out of the struggling word

parts.note: floundering means struggling helplessly
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone battling to lose weight wonders about going to bed early.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'bed' is the sea bed: a ship sinking is heading there.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that sinks goes down to the sea floor, so 'going to bed' is a playful gloss.

clue.text: Stick holding short scroll in minister's office

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the scroll sits inside the stick word

parts.note: paste is to stick with glue

indicators.note: short means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: the Torah is the Jewish scroll of the law

explanation.surface: A rod with a little scroll attached hangs in a clergyman's office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the final letter of the scroll's name before it goes inside; 'Stick' is the verb, to glue, not a staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastor's position or term of office as a church minister is a pastorate.

clue.text: Complication in party line

parts.note: a rave is a big dance party

explanation.surface: Trouble breaks out in the queue for a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangle or knot, figuratively an intricacy or complication.

clue.text: Very ready to turn tail seeing river danger

indicators.note: turning the tail means swapping round the final two letters of the word

parts.note: eager means keen, very ready

explanation.surface: Someone keen to flee on seeing a hazard on the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn tail' reverses only the tail of EAGER, ER becoming RE. An eagre is a tidal bore, such as the one on the Severn.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal bore is a wave surging up an estuary, a hazard for boats.

clue.text: Dive from height into water, say — there's no answer to that

indicators.note: into means the height is put inside the water word

parts.note: the sea is water
a peak is a high point

indicators.note: there's no tells us a letter is missing from the word say

parts.note: taken as written before losing a letter

explanation.surface: A diver plunges from a cliff into the sea, and there's nothing to say about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dive' looks like the plunge, but it means a seedy bar; a speakeasy was an illicit drinking den during US Prohibition.
explanation.definitionFit: A dive is a disreputable bar, and an illegal drinking club is exactly that.

clue.text: Incomer is a stranger in islands

indicators.note: stranger read as 'more strange', telling us the letters become odder in arrangement

explanation.surface: A newcomer is an outsider on the islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stranger' looks like a noun but is the comparative adjective signalling the rearrangement; 'in' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Micronesia is a Pacific region made up of thousands of small islands.

clue.text: Area one has run through

indicators.note: has, with through, says the run goes through the middle of the one word

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone has dashed across a patch of land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has ... through' puts R inside ACE.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a unit of area, about 4,047 square metres.

clue.text: Rodent is fine, overcoming painful condition

indicators.note: overcoming read as coming over and around, so fine encloses the condition

parts.note: A1 means first-rate or fine, written AI
gout is a painful inflammation of the joints

explanation.surface: A rat recovers from a bout of gout.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first-class) is written with the digit read as the letter I. The agouti is a South American rodent.
explanation.definitionFit: The agouti is a long-legged burrowing rodent of Central and South America.

clue.text: Baby may be angry

definitions.meaning: a baby is often carried, held in someone's embrace

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means held in someone's embrace, and idiomatically means protesting furiously.

clue.text: Stand well back, somewhat dirty

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read backwards
somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Keep your distance from that rather filthy thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Dirty in the sense of smutty or obscene matches lewd.

clue.text: Time to kill?

parts.note: read as idle time to pass, but really the period when hunting a quarry is legal

explanation.definitionFit: This is the season when hunting game is permitted, literally a time for killing.

clue.text: Exotic sort of tide pushed initially into heap

indicators.note: into means these pieces go inside the heap word

parts.note: a pile is a heap
a neap tide is the smallest tide of the lunar cycle

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of pushed

explanation.surface: An unusual kind of tide first shoves its way into a mound of stuff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exotic' is used as a noun, a plant or fruit from abroad; 'initially' supplies the first letter of 'pushed', which follows the tide inside the heap.
explanation.definitionFit: An exotic is a foreign plant or fruit, and this tropical fruit is a classic example.

clue.text: Rails having extremely strange meat hooked up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the assembly is read from bottom to top
extremely takes the outer letters of strange

parts.note: liver is offal eaten as meat

explanation.surface: Railings with very odd meat hung on hooks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rails' looks like a noun but is the verb, to rail against; SE plus LIVER is reversed by 'hooked up'.
explanation.definitionFit: To rail at someone is to abuse them verbally, the same as to revile.

clue.text: Both bits very strongly tucked in to fix hair

indicators.note: tucked in to means placed inside the fix word

parts.note: to cure meat or fish is to preserve it, to fix it so it keeps
the two binary digits, 0 and 1, look like the letters O and I
ff, fortissimo, is the musical direction for very loud

explanation.surface: A hairdresser tucks both pieces in very firmly to fix the hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Both bits' means the two binary digits 0 and 1, read as letters. 'fix' as in preserve, like curing bacon.
explanation.definitionFit: A coiffure is a hairstyle, a styled arrangement of hair.

clue.text: Retire, having found one way to get rota set up

parts.words: one way to get rota set up
parts.note: the second part, if its letters were disturbed, would give the words rota set up

explanation.surface: Someone retires after finding a way to get the duty roster organised.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as an instruction: disturb (put out) the letters of its final two words and you get ROTA SET UP.
explanation.definitionFit: To send a person or animal out to grass is to retire them from active work.

clue.text: Make secret garden, almost penetrated by officer

indicators.note: penetrated by means the officer goes inside the garden word
almost cuts off the last letter

parts.note: Eden is the biblical garden
NCO is a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: A garden is made private, nearly overrun by an officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the garden's last letter, and 'penetrated by' puts the officer inside what remains; NCO is a non-commissioned officer such as a sergeant.
explanation.definitionFit: To encode a message is to put it into code, making it secret.

clue.text: Breathe in, out — imperceptibly, if one does this?

definitions.text: Breathe in, out — imperceptibly, if one does this?

indicators.note: out means the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: An animal breathing almost invisibly while asleep through winter.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffled, the letters of 'Breathe in' give the answer, and the whole clue describes the barely noticeable breathing of a dormant animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals that sleep through winter slow their breathing until it is barely detectable.

clue.text: Fill me with spirit, last of grog mixture

indicators.note: fill means the other pieces are put inside the word me

parts.note: taken as written
elan is dash or spirit

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of grog

explanation.surface: A drinker asks to be topped up with liquor, the last of the grog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' looks like strong drink alongside 'grog', but it means verve, ELAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A melange is a mixture or medley of different things.

clue.text: This time in dock in Italian city, I left to get sandwich

indicators.note: left means departed, so the letter I goes from the city

parts.note: Turin is a city in northern Italy
taken as written
a round is a sandwich made from two whole slices of bread

explanation.surface: A ship in an Italian port while someone leaves to grab a sandwich.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dock' is a ship's berth: the answer is the time a ship spends unloading and reloading.
explanation.definitionFit: The turnaround of a ship is the period it spends in port between voyages.

clue.text: Quietly digging into strata, working as amateur

indicators.note: digging into means the quiet piece goes inside the strata

parts.note: strata are layers of rock
p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
on means functioning, working

explanation.surface: A hobbyist quietly digs into rock layers.
explanation.definitionFit: A layperson is a non-professional, someone without expert training.

clue.text: Decay overwhelms a northern island group

indicators.note: overwhelms means the decay surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: caries is tooth decay

explanation.surface: Rot engulfs a cluster of islands in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: The Canaries are an archipelago of Spanish islands off north-west Africa.

clue.text: All expectant by the fire?

parts.note: at means beside, by
an ingle is a fireside or hearth fire

explanation.surface: Everyone sits eagerly waiting beside the hearth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All' belongs to the definition: the answer means thrilling with excitement throughout.
explanation.definitionFit: Tingling with anticipation, a state of nervous expectancy.

clue.text: Matches: a q-quantity of wood beginning to smoulder

parts.note: the stammer doubles the first letter of the wood measure, a cord

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of smoulder

explanation.surface: Matches need just a quantity of wood to start smouldering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Matches' tempts as fire-lighters beside 'wood' and 'smoulder', but it is the verb meaning agrees with. The stammered 'q-quantity' gives C-CORD, a cord being a stack of cut firewood.
explanation.definitionFit: To accord with something is to match or agree with it.

clue.text: Film company's short: The Meaning of Green and Blue

indicators.note: short means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: an indie is an independent film company
a green light means go

explanation.surface: A small studio's short film is titled after the meaning of colours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the E from INDIE; a green traffic light tells you to go.
explanation.definitionFit: This deep violet-blue is one of the colours of the rainbow.
